questions.question: Welcome! Let's start with your full name. What should appear at the top of your resume?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Sarah Jenkins or Alex Morgan
questions.tip: Use your official name as you want recruiters and background checkers to see it.

questions.question: What is your current job, profession or occupation? You can describe it in your own words.
questions.placeholder: e.g., Stock Department Worker, Teacher, or Software Engineer
questions.tip: Enter any profession or job title in your own words, or choose from suggestions.

questions.question: What is the best email address for recruiters to reach you?
questions.tip: Use a professional, clean email address.

questions.question: What phone number should we include on your resume?
questions.tip: Include country or area code for clarity.

questions.question: Where are you currently located?
questions.tip: City and State or Country is sufficient. Full street address is not needed.

questions.question: Do you have a LinkedIn profile link? (Optional)
questions.tip: Over 85% of tech recruiters view LinkedIn profiles before interviewing.

questions.question: Do you have a GitHub or code repository link? (Optional)
questions.tip: Great for showcasing your open-source work and coding style.

questions.question: Do you have a personal portfolio website or blog? (Optional)
questions.tip: A custom domain or clean portfolio link leaves a memorable impression.

questions.question: Which best describes your current professional experience level?
questions.tip: This will customize the questions and recommend the best ATS layout for you.

questions.question: Let's craft your Professional Summary. You can pick an ATS-optimized template below or write your own:
questions.tip: A 2-4 sentence pitch highlighting your key strengths and technical passions.

questions.question: Let's add your education. What degree or diploma did you pursue?
questions.tip: Include major or specialization if applicable.

questions.question: Which college, school, or institution did you attend?
questions.tip: Official name of the university or institution.

questions.question: What year did you start your studies?
Are you currently studying here, or have you graduated?
What is your graduation year (or expected graduation year)?
What was your GPA or percentage? (Optional)
questions.tip: Recommended if 3.5+ GPA or top 10% of class. Otherwise safe to skip.

questions.question: Education record saved! Do you want to add another degree or educational qualification?
Would you like to add work experience or internships to your resume?
questions.tip: For freshers, academic projects and internships can serve as great experience.

questions.question: What was your job title / role?
What is the company or organization name?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Google, Stripe, or Stealth Startup

questions.question: What type of employment was this?
Where was this job located?
questions.placeholder: e.g., New York, NY (Hybrid) or Remote

questions.question: Are you currently working in this role?
When did you start this position?
When did you complete this position?
What were your core responsibilities and achievements? (Click suggestions below to quickly populate)
questions.placeholder: Describe what you built, improved, or delivered. Use action verbs and numbers where possible...
questions.tip: Tip: Start bullets with action verbs (Architected, Spearheaded, Reduced, Delivered).

questions.question: Experience record saved! Would you like to add another work experience?
Select your technical skills across categories, or type your own custom skills below:
questions.tip: Select at least 5-10 core skills matching your target job descriptions.

questions.question: Would you like to highlight notable projects, open source work, or apps you've built?
questions.tip: Projects are the #1 way for freshers & self-taught devs to demonstrate real competence.

questions.question: What is the project title?
questions.placeholder: e.g., E-Commerce Microservices or AI Code Assistant

questions.question: Briefly describe what this project does and the problem it solves:
questions.placeholder: e.g., A full-stack web application that allows users to track expenses and get automated budget insights.

questions.question: What technologies, libraries, or databases were used?
questions.placeholder: e.g., React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker

questions.question: What is the repository URL or live demo link? (Optional)
What were your key contributions or notable technical achievements?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Integrated JWT authentication and reduced page load times by 40% with memoization...

questions.question: Project saved! Do you want to add another project?
Do you hold any professional certifications, licenses, or course badges to include? (Optional)
What is the certificate or credential name?
questions.placeholder: e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Meta Frontend Developer

questions.question: Which organization or authority issued this credential?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud, Coursera

questions.question: When was it issued?
Do you have a verification URL or badge link? (Optional)
Certification saved! Would you like to add another certification?
Would you like to include awards, competition placements, or key achievements? (Optional)
What was the achievement or honor title?
Briefly describe the context or impact:
questions.placeholder: e.g., Awarded out of 120+ teams for creating an accessible audio navigation system.

questions.question: What year was this achieved?
Achievement saved! Would you like to add another achievement?
What languages do you speak or write? (Click to pick or add custom)
questions.tip: Multilingual candidates often stand out in international and remote teams.

questions.question: Any personal interests, hobbies, or passions to showcase your personality? (Optional)
questions.placeholder: e.g., Open Source, Robotics, Marathon Running
questions.tip: Helpful icebreakers in interview conversations.

questions.question: 🎉 Incredible job! All sections are complete. Which ATS-friendly template would you like to use for your resume?
questions.tip: You can preview and change templates anytime with live rendering.
